component.name: Aurora SD Tool
component.summary: Install and manage the Aurora game trainer for Steam Play titles

description.p: Aurora SD Tool installs the Aurora game trainer on Linux and registers it as a Steam Play compatibility tool, so a game launched from Steam starts with Aurora attached to it.

It detects Proton builds across every Steam library folder, including Flatpak and distro-packaged runners, lets you pick a Proton version per game or globally, and manages non-Steam launchers such as Ubisoft Connect and the Epic Games Store.

This package adds Linux desktop integration on top of the upstream Steam Deck build: an XDG-compliant install layout, a launcher that works from a read-only system prefix, dependency diagnostics, and support for distributions beyond SteamOS.
Upstream 3.2.0, with Linux packaging and desktop integration:

ul.li: Complete "Aurora Deck" UI redesign with Status, Games and Tools tabs
Runs correctly from a read-only system prefix such as /usr
Startup diagnostics for missing libraries, XWayland and Steam
